title: Person: Little
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Little

anchor.prefix: ie. You could die just the same on a sunny day. He might die before his mother came. Then he would have a dead mass in the chapel like the way the fellows had told him it was when
anchor.suffix: had died. All the fellows would be at the mass, dressed in black, all with sad faces. Wells too would be there but no fellow would look at him. The rector would be there in a cope
